The P3s: a card stretched to its row still leaves a band under its content (n88 .17, n90 .26, n92 .44; the probe found n70's 165 px and n76's 37 to 55 px still open), a focused x label at 390 drops its neighbours and a y chip covers a tick at 1800 (n89 .19, n88's 0 % tick), a bar value label shares a row with an axis tick (n91 .31), a `phone: 'columns'` table is wider than its card at 390 (n91 .33, .36), two panes of one card put their x ticks 22 px apart (n91), and `BarListItem.secondary` takes no maybe-value although the shipped rule says an optional field takes one (n90 marker).
